The enrichment data clearly points to **Arachidonic Acid Metabolism (KEGG map00590)** as the central affected pathway, with 6 of 8 input metabolites matching (fold-enrichment ~643, FDR 0.0 across the top SMPDB pathways, all of which reference this core KEGG route). Membership of Arachidonic acid (C00219), Leukotriene A4 (C00909), 5-HETE (C04805), and 15-Deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2 (C14717) was confirmed in that pathway. The KEGG reaction graph confirms that **arachidonic acid is a direct upstream precursor of Leukotriene A4** (via one intermediate, C05356, 2 hops) and of **5-HETE** (also via C05356, 2 hops, forward direction). The 15-HETE and 5,6-Epoxy-8,11,14-eicosatrienoic acid sit on the cytochrome-P450/LOX branch of the same network. The two phenolic acids (3,4-dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid, 4-hydroxybenzoic acid) appear to be independent markers, likely reflecting downstream oxidative-stress or phase-II biotransformation activity.

The metabolomics signature is dominated by disturbances in **Arachidonic Acid Metabolism (KEGG map00590)**, with six of the eight differentially-abundant metabolites mapping to this pathway. **Arachidonic acid (C00219)** is the principal upstream driver: KEGG reaction-graph analysis confirms it is a direct metabolic precursor of **Leukotriene A4 (C00909)** and **5-HETE (C04805)** (each reachable via one intermediate in two enzymatic steps). This positions arachidonic acid at the branch point that gates both the lipoxygenase (5-HETE / leukotriene) and the downstream prostaglandin/bradykinin branches. **15-HETE (C04742)** and **5,6-Epoxy-8,11,14-eicosatrienoic acid (C14768)** represent the parallel cytochrome-P450/LOX oxidation arm of the same cascade, while **15-Deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2 (C14717)** is a cyclopentenone prostaglandin derivative that signals through the electrophilic stress-response pathway.

Biological significance: coordinated elevation or depletion of these eicosanoids reflects altered phospholipase-A₂ activity and differential cyclooxygenase/lipoxygenase/cytochrome-P450 flux. Leukotriene A4 is the pivotal precursor of the potent leukotriene inflammatory mediators; 5-HETE and 15-HETE are themselves bioactive lipid signals that regulate neutrophil chemotaxis, angiogenesis, and immune resolution. 15-Deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2 acts as an electrophile that covalently modifies NF-κB pathway proteins, exerting anti-inflammatory effects. Meanwhile, the presence of **3,4-dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid** and **4-hydroxybenzoic acid** suggests secondary activation of oxidative stress or xenobiotic biotransformation pathways, potentially downstream of the same inflammatory insult. Collectively, the profile is consistent with a mixed inflammatory-eicosanoid storm in which the eicosanoid arm is rewired — with implications for inflammatory diseases, pain amplification, or altered vascular tone depending on the treatment context.

The KEGG reaction graph confirms that arachidonic acid is a metabolic precursor of **Leukotriene A4** (via one intermediate in two enzymatic steps) and of **5-HETE** (same path length, forward direction). The remaining metabolites (15-HETE, 5,6-Epoxy-8,11,14-eicosatrienoic acid, 3,4-dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid, 4-hydroxybenzoic acid) are also enriched in the same eicosanoid cluster, suggesting they are part of the same metabolic perturbation but cannot all be directly linked on the same reaction branch.
